name: WISDM Smartphone and Smartwatch Activity and Biometrics Dataset
description: WISDM Smartphone and Smartwatch Activity and Biometrics Dataset contains 15,630,426 raw triaxial accelerometer and gyroscope sensor readings collected at 20 Hz from 51 human subjects performing 18 diverse daily physical activities with both a phone and smartwatch. Published in IEEE Access 2019, it benchmarks wearable activity recognition, mobile biometrics, and sensor time-series classification.
